The Theoretical Computer Science group at the ILLC in Amsterdam is looking for an Assistant Professor (with tenure) to work on machine learning for formal reasoning and verification. See here for the full call. I allow myself to highlight:

We particularly welcome candidates whose work connects modern AI and machine learning with formal proof systems, interactive theorem provers, or proof assistants such as Lean, Rocq, or Isabelle. At the same time, we also encourage applications from researchers whose work engages more broadly with logic, reasoning, and theoretical computer science.

Application deadline is 7 October 2026. If you have general questions about what working at the ILLC is like, also feel free to message or email me. For questions about the position, please contact b.d.tencate@uva.nl.
